index.html:
<html><head><link href="https://cdn.syncfusion.com/ej2/33.1.44/{{theme}}.css" rel="stylesheet">

    <link href="https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.7/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
            body{
                touch-action:none;
            }
            .control-section{
                margin-top:100px;
            }
        </style></head><body><div class="stackblitz-container {{theme}}">
<div class="control-section visio-import-container">
    <link href="https://ej2.syncfusion.com/javascript/demos/src/diagram/styles/diagram-common.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        /* These styles are used for toolbar icons*/
        @font-face {
            font-family: 'e-ddb-icons';
            src: url(data:application/x-font-ttf;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('truetype');
            font-weight: normal;
            font-style: normal;
        }

        @font-face {
            font-family: 'Bootstrap5 Diagram Builder';
            src:
                url(data:application/x-font-ttf;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('truetype');
            font-weight: normal;
            font-style: normal;
        }

        [class^="sf-icon-"],
        [class*=" sf-icon-"] {
            font-family: 'Bootstrap5 Diagram Builder' !important;
            /* speak: none; */
            font-size: 55px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-weight: normal;
            font-variant: normal;
            text-transform: none;
            line-height: 1;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
        }


        .sf-icon-elipse:before {
            content: "\e8c4";
        }

        .sf-icon-line-1:before {
            content: "\e8c5";
        }

        .sf-icon-orthogonal:before {
            content: "\e8c6";
        }

        .sf-icon-bezier:before {
            content: "\e8c7";
        }

        .e-ddb-icons {
            font-family: 'e-ddb-icons';
            speak: none;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-weight: normal;
            font-variant: normal;
            text-transform: none;
            line-height: 1;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
        }

        /* Icon css in dropdown */
        .e-basic::before {
            content: "\e726";
        }

        .e-flow::before {
            content: "\e724";
        }

        #diagram-functionalities .e-connector::before {
            content: "\e725";
        }

        .visio-import-container .e-file-select-wrap {
            display: none;
        }

        /* Toolbar width */
        .visio-import-container .db-toolbar-editor {
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* symbolpalette width */
        .visio-import-container #symbolpalette {
            width: 90%;
        }

        /* Overall div width */
        .visio-import-container .main {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .visio-import-container .diagram-upload-file {
            display: none;
        }
    </style>
    <div class="main" id="diagram-functionalities">
        <div class="diagram-upload-file"><input type="file" id="fileupload" name="UploadFiles"></div>
        <div class="db-toolbar-editor">
            <div class="db-toolbar-container">
                <div id="toolbar"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sb-mobile-palette-bar">
            <div id="palette-icon" role="button" class="e-ddb-icons1 e-toggle-palette"></div>
        </div>
        <div id="palette-space" class="sb-mobile-palette">
            <div id="symbolpalette"></div>
        </div>
        <div id="diagram-space" class="sb-mobile-diagram">
            <div id="diagram"></div>
        </div>
        <div id="toast"></div>
    </div>
</div>


</div></body></html>
